## Load the packages we will need (if a package is still not in installed, use install.packages("PackageName") to install it).

```{r, print = FALSE}
library(rworldmap);library(rgdal);library(raster);library(plotfunctions);library(bRacatus);library(rgbif)


```


## Download species data from GBIF

```{r}
#Colotis fausta
#Maniola telmessia

koala <- occ_search(scientificName="Maniola telmessia",
                      hasCoordinate=T)
koala_pts <- koala[[3]]
koala_pts2 <- giveOcc(koala_pts, 
                         longitude = "decimalLongitude",
                         latitude = "decimalLatitude")
coordinates(koala_pts) <- ~decimalLongitude+decimalLatitude  #inform coordinates
  
#visualise
plotOcc(koala_pts2)
```


## download bioclimatic variables (raster stack)

```{r}

bioclim <- getData("worldclim", var="bio", res=10)
class(bioclim)
nlayers(bioclim)
bioclim[[1]]
anual_mean_temp <- bioclim[[1]]
class(anual_mean_temp)
plot(anual_mean_temp)
```


## Crop the raster to the area of study

```{r}
extent(anual_mean_temp)
extent(koala_pts)
study_area <- crop(anual_mean_temp,extent(koala_pts))
plot(study_area)
plot(sp.occr_loc,add=T,pch=19,cex=.5) #run with previous line
```

## Visualising another layer of the raster stack, and crop the whole area of Australia

```{r}
anual_prec <- bioclim[[12]]
plot(anual_prec)
australia_prec <- crop(anual_prec,extent(23,85,5,40))
australia_temp <- crop(anual_mean_temp,extent(23,85,5,40))
plot(australia_prec)
plot(koala_pts,add=T,pch=19,cex=.5)
```


```{r}
australia_var <- stack(australia_prec,australia_temp)
australia_var

t_bioclim <- bioclim(australia_var,koala_pts)

pred.full <- predict(t_bioclim, australia_var)

plot(pred.full) # plotting the prediction
points(koala_pts, col="red") + title("Maniola telmessia SDM - Present only")

plot(australia_var[[1]])#mean SST is the first element in the raster stack
plot(koala_pts,add=T)
```
```{r}
sp.absent <- australia_var[[1]]  %>% # take the first layer of environmental data 
  rasterToPoints() %>%  # get the coordinate points
  as_tibble()  %>% # turn into a data table
  sample_n(1000) %>%  # randomly sample 1000 rows
    # we don't actually need the tmean column for this
  rename(lon = x,
         lat = y) %>% 
  mutate(occurrence = 0)

sp_data_psd <- bind_rows(sp.occr_loc,sp.absent)

sp_data_psd <- sp_data_psd %>% 
  replace_na(replace = list(occurrence = 1))

sp_name_psd <- sp_data_psd %>% select(occurrence)
sp_data_psd <- sp_data_psd %>% select(lon,lat)
```

```{r}
koalas <- occ_search(scientificName="Colotis fausta",
                      hasCoordinate=T)
koalas_pts <- koalas[[3]]
koalas_pts2 <- giveOcc(koalas_pts, 
                         longitude = "decimalLongitude",
                         latitude = "decimalLatitude")
coordinates(koalas_pts) <- ~decimalLongitude+decimalLatitude  #inform coordinates
  
#visualise
plotOcc(koalas_pts2)
```


## Crop the raster to the area of study

```{r}
extent(anual_mean_temp)
extent(koalas_pts)
study_area2 <- crop(anual_mean_temp,extent(koalas_pts))
plot(study_area2)
plot(koalas_pts,add=T,pch=19,cex=.5) #run with previous line
```

## Visualising another layer of the raster stack, and crop the whole area of Australia

```{r}
anual_prec <- bioclim[[12]]
plot(anual_prec)
australia_prec <- crop(anual_prec,extent(33,82,5,40))
australia_temp <- crop(anual_mean_temp,extent(33,82,5,40))
plot(australia_prec)
plot(koalas_pts,add=T,pch=19,cex=.5)
```


## Extracting values from rasters at point locations



```{r}
#do not use for now
values <- extract(australia_var,koala_pts)
head(values)
class(values)
values <- as.data.frame(values)
class(values)
min_temp <- min(values$bio1)
max_temp <- max(values$bio1)
min_prec <- min(values$bio12)
max_prec <- max(values$bio12)
```


## Produce a very simple SDM for the Koala

```{r}

climatic_suitability <- australia_prec
for(i in 1:length(climatic_suitability[]))
{
  climatic_suitability[i] <- ifelse(australia_temp[i] > min_temp &
                            australia_temp[i] < max_temp &
                            australia_prec[i] > min_prec &
                            australia_prec[i] < max_prec,
                            1,0)
  
}
plot(climatic_suitability)
```
